source.check: returned unopposed: no more nominations than seats; 'Inver will be the only ward in which there will be a contest' (Larne Times, 8 May 1952, p. 5, image-read), and none withdrew, so Inver's councillorships were the only poll (Larne Times, 15 May 1952, p. 4)

note: Election of the Larne Borough Council, May 1952: one alderman and two councillors for each of the five wards, 15 seats. Sixteen nominations were received; the only poll, on Wednesday 21 May 1952, was for the two Inver Ward councillorships (Belfast News-Letter, 22 May 1952, p. 5). Every other alderman and councillor was returned unopposed (Larne Times, 8 May 1952, p. 5, which prints every nomination; 15 May 1952, p. 4). No party labels are printed. Returned unopposed.
